reason: I don't take supplements unless my doctor says to, and I can't even keep up with the vitamins I already have on the counter. A named lab report is nice, but it doesn't tell me I need magnesium.
objection: Nobody has told me I need this, and 30 foil sachets a month is a lot of packaging waste for something I'd probably forget to take.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me to take magnesium, plus a sachet that is recyclable.
